notes.title: Welcome to our workshop!
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45659609/95d8ebef86dded162c2cbd9d6b78220e52835149.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Please welcome[/b]: [i]60 Seconds! Souper Scavenger[/i], our newest title, designed in-house from scratch and fully powered by the Godot Engine. It’s quick, it’s chaotic, and it’s our first complete step into a brand-new production pipeline.[/p][p]But while you scavenge, remember this: two new games are already deep in development. Two![/p][p]You haven’t seen the main event. Not yet.[/p]
